title: Woojoo
description:
“Woojoo”
The debut animation in the Woojoo series.
Drawing from the artist’s personal experience of navigating a completely foreign environment, this story follows an alien protagonist—an avatar for the artist herself. Having landed somewhere she has never been before, Woojoo begins her journey as a guarded, plan-oriented newcomer.
The narrative captures that lonely, defensive feeling of being an outsider, where every interaction feels like a risk and sticking to a rigid plan is the only way to feel safe. However, the story shifts when an unexpected act of kindness from a stranger begins to soften Woojoo’s heart. It’s about the vulnerability of being new and the moment you realize that true belonging requires letting go of your original, solitary ambitions to finally connect with a community.
